summary: Implemented an Intermittent Fasting dashboard panel with real-time timer/progress and KPI-style summaries, wired to show when the fasting factor is selected. However, the spec’s “Starts In…” status state is not evident, and some layout/accessibility integration aspects (non-overlap with markers/helix across breakpoints) cannot be fully verified from the truncated diff. Several broader UI/theme/background changes were made that were not requested by the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Include a current status block that can show “Fasting / Eating Window / Starts In…” (phase-aware status variants).
missing_requirements.reason: The timer hook and panel logic only show two phases ('fasting'|'eating') and only render fasting vs eating strings; no third 'starts in' state or copy path is shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Integrate the fasting panel into StartDashboard responsively without obscuring helix visuals or overlapping factor marker cards; preserve marker click and keyboard accessibility.
missing_requirements.reason: StartDashboard and IntermittentFastingPanel integration details (exact placement, container layout, z-index/spacing rules) are truncated; the diff summary confirms conditional rendering but does not provide enough evidence to verify non-overlap and responsive stacking/overflow behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Global theme/color system overhaul (OKLCH palette changes, new genome/scientific styling utilities).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on adding a fasting dashboard section; it does not request redesigning global colors/typography/utilities.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to helix/marker visuals and animations (more filigree helix, adjusted spacing, animated background updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; requirements only ask that the fasting panel integrate without breaking existing interactions/visuals, not to redesign helix components.

hallucinated_features.description: FactorMarker component changes (icon mapping, interaction/accessible states updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested by the fasting-panel requirements; could be beneficial but is outside scope per BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Forced dark mode behavior and root HTML changes to prevent light flash on first paint.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest only mentions consistency with existing dark theme, not enforcing dark mode globally via App/index.html changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Added placeholder React Query hook file for future backend integration.
hallucinated_features.reason: Explicitly out of scope/non-goal to add backend persistence/integration work; placeholder file is not requested for fasting dashboard UI.
